version.note: The item identifies the whole Idyll but not a performing edition. The listening-stage diagram describes broad regions of the published score; exact acoustic session staffing or substitutions are not established.

performers.note: The item title names the orchestra and embedded MP3 creator names Chapple.

date.note: The item describes a 1925 acoustic pressing; the independent collector discography dates the matching issue circa 1925. The item’s machine date 1925-03-03 is not independently established as a session day.

place.note: The independent collector discography locates the matching Chapple/Modern Chamber Orchestra issue in London. The selected transfer’s own metadata supplies no venue, and no particular studio is established.

label.note: Historical acoustic issue identified by the item description and filename.

catalogue.value: K5157–K5158 in title/description; K0557–K0558 in embedded tags
catalogue.note: The digit strings disagree within the selected item. The independent collector lists K-05157 and K-05158, supporting the title/description rather than the shorter embedded-tag numbers; the internal discrepancy remains visible.

matrixTakeSides.note: The selected item documents four sides. The matrix series is corroboration for the matching issue, not a transcription of inspected labels from the selected copy; take suffixes and precise digital side joins remain unestablished.

credits.note: Embedded comment explicitly credits the transfer, rather than merely identifying the uploader.

date.note: Embedded comment says “2021 transfer from Animating Apothecary Archives”.

processing.note: No restoration or editing history is established.

digital.format: Internet Archive MP3 transfer of a four-side acoustic Vocalion issue

composition.value: Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies.
composition.note: Wagner died in 1883. This is a term calculation, not worldwide clearance of every edition.

recording.value: US public domain under the project’s pre-1926 publication rule; source identifies a 1925 pressing.
recording.note: The Internet Archive item supplies the historical publication evidence, not an explicit free-licence URL. Its 1925 dating is preserved as the source claim; catalogue-number disagreement is disclosed. The US term ends 31 December 2025; no worldwide clearance is implied.

rights.creditLine: Wagner: Siegfried Idyll; Modern Chamber Orchestra, Stanley Chapple; Vocalion acoustic issue dated 1925 by the source. Transfer 2021, Animating Apothecary Archives, via Internet Archive. US public domain from 1 January 2026.
